providers.signIn.title: Sign in for EYAS
providers.signIn.desc: EYAS runs {{provider}} in its own home and does not use the CLI's login on this computer. Sign in once for EYAS. The device code works from any browser, even when the server has none.
providers.signIn.start: Sign in with a device code
providers.signIn.codeHint: Open the page on any device, sign in, and check that it shows this code.
providers.signIn.waiting: Waiting for you to confirm the code…
providers.signIn.signedInApiKey: {{provider}} uses the API key stored in EYAS.
providers.signIn.expired: The code expired before it was confirmed.
providers.signIn.rawPrompt: EYAS could not find a link in the CLI's output. Follow what it says:
providers.signIn.apiKeyHint: The key is stored encrypted in EYAS Secrets and is passed only to {{provider}} runs. Usage is billed to the xAI API account, not to a Grok subscription. A device sign-in takes precedence over the key.
providers.signIn.requiredHint: {{provider}} is not signed in for EYAS. Open the provider to sign in.
providers.signIn.loadFailed: Could not read the sign-in state.
providers.signIn.banner.title: {{provider}} needs a sign-in for EYAS
providers.signIn.banner.desc: EYAS runs {{provider}} in its own home, so the CLI's login on this computer is not used. Sign in once for EYAS.
